plausibility_notes: Laboratory findings establish targeted glass contamination and a transfer through a common fragrance miniature; a freshly broken original fragment in favor paper links theft to repackaging.

Al is now the strongest target: plaster corroborates his glass contact, and his favor was directly beside the glass. However, he admitted contact and called the favor unopened; trace on the outside can be innocent, and the waste miniature lacks a recipient name. A firm accusation is not yet uniquely justified.
Brie remains credible through towel contact and deliberate service absence; Monet enabled that absence. Clear food, shared punch, PROP and FIXER narrow method without proving their owners innocent.
